feeds.title: Bright Classroom Ideas
feeds.description: We are a group of active educators sharing our everyday experiences in the classroom. We share news, trends, research, ideas, and technologies that shape the future of learning. We support teaching through professional development, thought leadership, and resource curation.

feeds.title: The Texas OnCourse Educator Blog
feeds.description: Deciding what to do after high school and how to do it can be confusing. We're here to help. As a state-funded initiative to improve college and career readiness, our mission is to equip all Texas students for an educational and professional future that unlocks their potential. Texas OnCourse empowers you to make decisions that will help you, your child or your student succeed after high school.

feeds.title: Breakthrough Central Texas Blog
feeds.description: Breakthrough Central Texas serves as a collaborative network of 24 affiliates throughout the U.S. by providing program standards and resources including curricula, evaluation tools, and teaching fellow recruitment. The mission is to build a path to college, starting in middle school, for low-income students who will be first-generation college graduates.

feeds.title: Educational Equity, Politics & Policy in Texas
feeds.description: This blog on Texas education contains posts on accountability, testing, K-12 education, postsecondary educational attainment, dropouts, bilingual education, immigration, school finance, environmental issues, Ethnic Studies at state and national levels. It also represents my digital footprint, of life and career, as a community-engaged scholar in the College of Education at the University of Texas at Austin.

feeds.title: Austin Monthly Magazine » Education
feeds.description: Austin Monthly Magazine is your guide to life in Austin - things to do, where to eat, and thought-provoking reads on the issues, trends, ideas, and people catalyzing the city. We also share articles on education in Austin, school news, and more.

feeds.title: AUSTIN CAREER INSTITUTE Blog
feeds.description: Read all about the trade school programs we offer, including Medical Assistant, HVAC-R, and Electrical Technician. We share insights on career paths, salary potentials, and graduate successes as well as general news about the Austin trade school scene where high school graduates can take their post-secondary education.

feeds.title: ReUp Education Blog
feeds.description: Whether you're new to the education space or a seasoned veteran seeking bold change, there's a place for you at ReUp - from careers in engineering to sales, to coaching, and everything in between. Keep up with the latest insights and ideas for achieving your goals in higher education.

feeds.title: Long-View Micro School Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Long-View Learning! We are an educational organization dedicated to innovation in support of higher levels of learning and teaching. We serve families and educators.

feeds.title: Escoffier Blog
feeds.description: Escoffier's take on culinary industry trends and topics. Auguste Escoffier School of Culinary Arts is a world-class culinary school based in Austin, TX, Boulder, CO. Stay up to date on culinary industry trends and topics with Escoffier's blog, including food entrepreneurship, culinary & pastry careers, plus much more.

feeds.title: Stepping Stone School Blog
feeds.description: Founded in Austin, Texas in 1979, Stepping Stone School is an organization of servant leaders who contribute experience, consistency, nurturance and security, to the school and community. Wonderful resources, insightful posts, how-tos, and fun ideas are just a few of the things featured on the Stepping Stone blog.

feeds.title: Alt Ed Austin Blog
feeds.description: Whether you're looking for outdoor learning and socialization for your little one, a balance of remote and in-person schooling for your elementary-aged child, inspiration and mentoring for your middle schooler, or a sense of purpose and challenge for your teen, you've come to the right place. Read on to learn how Alt Ed Austin can guide you through all the options.

feeds.title: Sweet Integrations
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sandy. I'm so glad you stopped by. I'll provide you with a wealth of technology tips, ideas for Project Based Learning, digital escape rooms, and resources for your classroom. I know how challenging it can be to implement collaborative projects in your classroom. Let me share my years of experience in teaching and technology to help you.

feeds.title: Southern Careers Institute Blog
feeds.description: Our purpose is to close the talent skills gap by elevating human capital and empowering individuals in new careers while adhering to the highest education and business standards. Read the latest posts and check out the full archive of career guides, education trends, and more on the Southern Careers Institute blog.

feeds.title: Kauffman Education Blog
feeds.description: David Kauffman is an educational leader committed to pursuing equitable opportunity and achievement for all students through inclusive and culturally sustaining practices. The purpose of this blog is to spark discussion about multilingual education and related topics.

feeds.title: Austin Partners in Education Blog
feeds.description: APIE provides college and career readiness support through individualized academic and mentoring programs to prepare students for success. Stay Up-to-Date on Everything APIE Supporting Students' Paths to Higher Education We help students develop their academic skills and confidence.

feeds.title: Abrome Blog
feeds.description: In order to prepare young people to do the remarkable, Abrome provides them with a non-coercive, psychologically safe, inclusive, interdependent community that allows them to identify and engage in deep, meaningful, and enduring learning experiences while being in relationship and co-creating culture with others.
